intent_snapshot.goal: Cut Kernel deterministic QA and native Review from detached session jobs/follow-up retrieval to one foreground Tool pipeline plus one reserved foreground standard Agent receipt, while deleting the superseded interactive background continuation route and preserving every existing authority, freshness, single-terminal, unknown-settlement, cancellation, and literal-user authorization invariant.

acceptance.assertion: imm_kernel_canary advance_assurance synchronously runs deterministic QA inside the foreground Tool call after fresh evidence: it captures the immutable snapshot, forwards the host AbortSignal through pre-verification and subprocess execution, applies exactly one QA approval/rework through revision CAS, emits bounded native progress/results, and returns one terminal state covering pass-to-review-ready, rework, cancellation, timeout, failure, or settlement_unknown. Cancellation before authority commit performs zero Kernel writes; cancellation after CAS cannot abandon settlement. Background QA jobs, heartbeats, timers, completion follow-ups, notify milestones, and cancel_assurance are deleted; host Escape/foreground Tool cancellation replaces command-owned cancel; Footer remains empty.

A session-local Review bridge owns one transient reservation per (task_id, operation_id, snapshot/bundle identity). Extension tool_call observation validates exact reserved foreground Agent arguments and native toolCallId; a matching tool_result supplies the result-content verdict and tool_execution_end only corroborates lifecycle without creating a second terminal. submit_review revalidates the fresh projection, parses the structured verdict, records a pending Review, and returns awaiting_user; request_authorization remains the sole literal-user confirmation that applies the verdict. Matching receipts are accepted exactly once; mismatched, duplicate, malformed, cancelled, provider-failed, stale, unreserved, crash-interrupted, or event-order-inverted results fail closed with zero writes; session shutdown garbage-collects transient reservations/receipts. Background spawn receipts, get_subagent_result, stop RPC, follow-up completion delivery, and late-notification deduplication are deleted. The extension-side package test copies remain byte-consistent with the same contract.

The atomic cutover preserves TaskIntent, descriptor, enrollment receipt, TaskRecord, finding, approval, capability, and authorization schemas; immutable snapshot binding, review bundle provenance, descriptor concurrency/budgets, waiver taxonomy, final-lock freshness, atomic TaskRecord/workspace/backend-claim behavior, reviewer authority, and completion gates remain unchanged. Canonical roadmap, Pi assurance Specs, subagent dispatch protocol, README, USER_GUIDE, source skills, packaged dist docs, package boundary/consumer/loader assertions, active runtime docs contracts, and executable structural contracts consistently require foreground QA/Review and an empty Footer; no active interactive Canary path launches background work, sends required follow-up notifications, polls status/results, or retains command-owned cancel. The complete Bun repository regression passes. Manual Pi TUI assurance progress/cancel smoke is required before using this cutover for another production Enrollment.

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts: observeToolCall accepts a matching reserved Agent invocation without requiring the reservation to be the only eligible task context or rejecting a second matching call after the first terminal lifecycle has completed; the bridge's exact-once reservation contract is therefore not enforced at the tool-call observation boundary.

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts: onSessionShutdown clears activeOperations and transient maps but only calls closeSessionInvocation for sessionInvocations and then awaits a resolved promise; an in-flight advance can continue after shutdown and perform QA or authority writes because advance does not check sessionGeneration/sessionActive during its phases.

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts: cancellation after runQa returns but before openInvocation or before applyVerdict's commit boundary is handled as cancelled, while cancellation during the surrounding non-atomic gap can race with authority setup; the implementation lacks a session/operation ownership check at each write boundary, so a superseded foreground call can still settle.

plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts: submitReview releases the reservation and removes evidence on malformed, failed, stale, or snapshot-mismatched receipts, but does not persist a terminal rejection marker; repeated submissions become indistinguishable from unreserved results and lose the required fail-closed receipt outcome provenance.
